displayName: OCI-AUTH-015: Authentication — Credential Dumping via LSASS
description:
Detects process access to LSASS memory indicative of credential dumping

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_auth_015", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%authentication%' AND "value" > 0
